Semantic radar needs more MAP space.

Cloudflare Edge Ingress (symmet-router)

  • Cloudflare Worker handles path-based reverse proxying: /studio (Viewer) vs /shop (Astro).
  • HTMLRewriter strips internal dev origins and injects CSP headers and theme tokens.
  • Social crawler sniffer serves prerendered OpenGraph cards to WhatsApp and Twitter without booting React.

Studio 3D Spatial & Watertight CSG Engine

  • Google Manifold-3D WebAssembly kernel cuts exact parametric voids for windows and doors with zero non-manifold edges.
  • Box-projected triplanar UV mapping ensures millimeter scale fidelity across wall corners without stretching.
  • GLB loader applies non-uniform per-axis scale factors to enforce real physical furniture catalog dimensions.

Mathematical Solvers & Vastu Rules

  • 10-pass wall clearance solver keeps luxury furniture flush against complex wall faces without penetration.
  • 60-radii x 12-angles outward polar spiral search recovers items accidentally dropped in walls, falling back to Shoelace centroid.
  • Vedic Vastu Shastra engine calculates cardinal compass alignments (Ishan, Agni, Vayavya, Nairutya) relative to true North.

Commercial BOQ & Supabase Persistence

  • 720-line commercial quoting engine aggregates SKU pricing, fabric finish multipliers, 18% GST, and Canara Bank RTGS details.
  • Single-pass save_project_transaction PostgreSQL RPC provides strict ACID guarantees for rooms, walls, and item placements.
  • Partial unique index on active_devices enforces single-seat retail licensing and prevents credential sharing.
